clauses.reason: One designation covers thirteen agencies under EO 7916 section 6. The primary parent text imposes continuing duties, not a February 1 sunset. Actual EO 8044 limits competitive coverage, and actual EO 8363/8467 changes leave the personnel-division designation intact; prior adjacent-number errors are corrected and disclosed. Complete EO 9830 Part III expressly revokes EO 7975-A, with a global May 1, 1947 effective date. No earlier end was found in the bounded searches and primary checks. All thirteen objects end together. See ANALYSIS.md for exact sources, independent commands, savings and coverage limits.

research_rationale:
The complete original page confirms one designation covering thirteen agencies under EO 7916 section 6. The complete EO 9830 and official pages 1, 3, 4 and 11 confirm express whole-order revocation effective May 1, 1947 and no target-specific saving. Primary EO 7916 pages 8–9 show a February 1, 1939 implementation bound followed by continuing director duties, so initial establishment does not exhaust the designation. Actual EO 8044 limits competitive coverage; actual EO 8363 changes parent section 3 and EO 8467 changes section 7. None changes section 6 or names EO 7975-A. Wrong adjacent instrument attributions in the prior review were corrected from original pages. No earlier end was found in the stated bounded searches and primary checks. Exact sources and limitations appear in ANALYSIS.md and SUPPLEMENT_RECEIPT.json.

savings.reason: The original contains no savings. The complete EO 9830 has no reservation of the target designation. Section 01.3 independently requires personnel offices; section 01.5 expressly continues and renames the Council of Personnel Administration. That separate institutional continuation is disclosed, rather than treated as continuation of the revoked thirteen-agency designation. No target-specific accrued or transferred right was found in these complete texts.
